title: Ioas remaster lab
intro: One page for every remaster of the Ioas clip: the original, your best gentle version (round-3 pick F), and full-strength AI regenerations with nothing of the original blended back, plus blends of the two you found clearest, ElevenLabs (realistic) and Sidon (clearest). Regenerators rebuild the voice, so they can sound much fuller and also change words; the lost-word count and the transcript difference under Reveal are information only, your ear decides. Paid service still to try: Auphonic Studio Voice (beta, about $1 per audio hour, 2 free hours a month) needs your signup. Not candidates: ai-coustics now sells real-time denoise only, Resemble's hosted API is discontinued, dolby.io is gone. Resemble Enhance and VoiceRestore were dropped from this round (they lost the most words and you did not favour them). New versions join this page as they finish.

desc.t3-mud7-wpe-deess: Best gentle chain (your round-3 pick F): MossFormer2 60 % + mud cut + gentle dereverb + de-esser
desc.api-eleven-isolation: ElevenLabs Voice Isolator (API, strongest and only setting)
desc.gen-voicefixer: VoiceFixer, full strength (generative restoration: noise, reverb, bandwidth)
desc.gen-resemble-l09: Resemble Enhance, full strength, denoise-before 0.9 (lambda), temperature 0.5
desc.gen-resemble-l05: Resemble Enhance, full strength, denoise-before 0.5, temperature 0.5
desc.gen-sidon: Sidon (2025, w2v-BERT 2.0 features + 48 kHz vocoder), full strength
desc.gen-voicerestore: VoiceRestore (flow-matching transformer + BigVGAN 24 kHz), full strength
desc.lab-eleven-lo+sidon-hi: ElevenLabs below 3.5 kHz (realism) + Sidon's regenerated band above 3.5 kHz (clarity)
desc.lab-eleven>sidon: Sidon run on ElevenLabs' cleaned output
desc.lab-eleven>lavasr: LavaSR v2 bandwidth extension (2026, Vocos) run on ElevenLabs' output
desc.gen-unipase: UniPASE (2026, built to avoid invented words; WavLM-based, 48 kHz with bandwidth extension), full strength
